text: プラスパワーは　ないのかしら　ポケモンの　こうげきりょくを　たかめるから　すきなのに

structure.jp: プラスパワーは　ないのかしら
structure.en: I wonder if there's no X Attack

structure.jp: ポケモンの　こうげきりょくを　たかめるから
structure.en: because it raises a Pokémon's Attack

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', and when it ends a sentence it leaves a let-down feeling hanging. すきなのに = 'and I like it, too...'.

patterns.name: 〜かしら
patterns.explanation: かしら at the end means 'I wonder', in a soft way mostly used by women. ないのかしら = 'I wonder if there isn't any'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a phrase gives the reason: 'because'. たかめるから = 'because it raises it'.
